Name: ChefRude's Better Grass Visibility for CP
Author: chefrude
Description:
This mod replaces mmanlapats mod that makes the grass semi-transparent so you can find small objects (animals, rocks, weeds, truffles, etc ) in plentiful grass. The grass still looks grassy but it's less of an annoyance.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9952282]mmanlapat[/url]'s mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4687?tab=description]Better Grass Visibility[/url], but recreated from scratch to include new grass types from SDV1.6 

How to install:
Content Pack Method (Recommended)
Prerequisite: install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=description]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
1. Place the [b][CP] ChefRudes Better Grass Visibility [/b]folder from the download into your "[b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b]" directory.
2. Launch Stardew Valley via StardewValleyModdingAPI executable.

To uninstall: remove the [b][CP] ChefRudes Better Grass Visibility[/b] folder from "Stardew Valley/Mods"

Incompatible with other mods that change the grass.png file.

Downloads.Description: Semi Transparent grass for SDV 1.6, SMAPI and CP 2.3+
